title: Phonological rule
source: [+syll⟨+high⟩]→[α back⟨β round⟩]/[+syllα backβ round]C0__ , All vowels will take on the [+/- back] value of the vowel that precedes it, regardless of the number of intervening consonants. If a vowel is [+ high], it will also take on the [+/- round] value of the preceding vowel, regardless of the number of intervening consonants.
translation: [+音节⟨+高⟩]→[α 后⟨β 圆⟩]/[+音节 α 后 β 圆]C0__ ，所有元音都将采用其前一个元音的[+/- 后]值，无论中间有多少辅音。如果元音是[+ 高]，它还将采用前一个元音的[+/- 圆]值，无论中间有多少辅音。
